The vehicle changes lane to pass a stopped vehicle, or turns at a junction, with other road users relying on its
indicator

scenario)
ODD-20 Ego speed: 46 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking

SG-09 (ASIL C): Avoid signalling a manoeuvre other than the one
performed

direction; on a mismatch hazard lights come on (FSR-09.01,
FSR-04.01)
